text_block_list.text: I'm itchin' to run, but these legs just<n>won't move...

text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Ya think my power's<n>skedaddled off
somewhere?

Looks like the fatigue is catching up<n>to her. This
might call for some<n>changes to her race schedule.
